subject: Re: Kickoff: honest privacy accounting for our DP-SGD pipelines
body:
Audit results are in, and they're spicy.

Of the four internal DP pipelines: two shuffle but report Poisson-subsampling epsilon. For pipeline P2 the honest shuffling bound puts effective epsilon at roughly 1.9x the reported value at their noise multiplier — that's a compliance conversation, not a rounding error. P1's gap is smaller but real. The other two genuinely Poisson-subsample; their reports stand.

Recommendation shaping up: migrate P1/P2 to balls-and-bins sampling — implementation-wise it's close to what their input pipelines already do, and our accounting for it gives bounds close to Poisson. Farah's dp_accounting integration passed review last week, so the accountants they'd need are already importable.

Risk: P2's team will push back on any noise increase before their July launch. The June validation runs matter precisely to show the utility cost is small — please keep that reservation week protected.

Yara
